Description: Workshop 5A. Trade + recon + audit REST endpoints (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, async recon, Envers history). Groups TICKET-ADV063 through ADV071.
Workshop 5B. JWT issuance, auth filter, SecurityFilterChain with URL + method RBAC. Groups TICKET-ADV072 through ADV074.
Workshop 5C. MockMvc auth tests, Testcontainers lifecycle + Liquibase verify, API versioning/deprecation. Groups TICKET-ADV075 through ADV080.

GOAL: single GET endpoint returning trades with optional filters + stable pagination metadata. DONE WHEN: GET /api/v1/trades returns JSON with content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages, last. ?status=PENDING&counterparty=Apex narrows without breaking on a single filter. ?sort=createdAt,desc orders newest first, no 500 on unknown property.

GOAL: create a trade from a validated body, return 201 + Location header. DONE WHEN: valid TradeRequest returns 201, Location: /api/v1/trades/{id}, created trade JSON. Invalid body (missing tradeRef, negative quantity, future tradeDate) returns 400 ProblemDetail. Controller never sees a raw Trade entity — only request + response DTOs.

GOAL: replace every mutable field of an existing trade in one idempotent call. DONE WHEN: PUT with a complete TradeRequest returns 200 + updated representation. Same PUT twice leaves the resource in the same final state — no duplicate side effects. Non-existent id returns 404 ProblemDetail, not 500.

GOAL: update only the status field via a dedicated sub-resource. DONE WHEN: PATCH with { status: MATCHED } returns 200 + updated trade. Invalid status (FOOBAR) returns 400 with a clear validation message. VIEWER role cannot call it — RBAC blocks before the controller (see ADV077).

GOAL: logically delete a trade so it leaves list responses but stays in the DB for audit. DONE WHEN: DELETE returns 204 No Content, empty body. After delete, GET /api/v1/trades no longer returns the row. A row physically remains in trades with deleted_at populated (verify via direct SQL).

GOAL: trigger a recon job asynchronously, return a pollable job handle. DONE WHEN: POST ReconRequest (from-date, to-date, optional counterpartyId) returns 202 Accepted, not 200. Body has jobId (UUID) + initial status QUEUED. Location header points at the future results endpoint for that job id.
GOAL: return the paginated recon breaks for a specific job. DONE WHEN: returns PagedResponse<ReconResultResponse>. ?page=0&size=50 respected. VIEWER, RECON_ANALYST, ADMIN can read; TRADER cannot.

GOAL: mark a single recon break resolved with a mandatory analyst note. DONE WHEN: PUT with { note: ... } returns 200 + updated break. status becomes RESOLVED, resolvedAt is now, resolutionNote carries the text. Empty/missing notes return 400.

GOAL: expose Envers revision history for a trade as JSON snapshots. DONE WHEN: returns an array of revisions oldest-first. Each entry has revisionId, revisionTimestamp, revisionType (ADD/MOD/DEL), changedBy, full snapshot. A never-edited trade still shows the initial ADD revision from creation.

GOAL: authenticate username/password, return a signed JWT carrying the user's roles. DONE WHEN: POST /api/auth/login with credentials returns 200 + { token, tokenType: Bearer, expiresIn }. Token decodes cleanly (sub, roles, iat, exp claims). Wrong credentials return 401, not 200 with a token.

GOAL: read the Bearer token per request, validate it, populate the security context. DONE WHEN: valid Authorization: Bearer arrives at the controller with SecurityContextHolder authentication populated. Missing/malformed/expired token still flows the chain but lands unauthenticated (downstream 401). Filter runs exactly once per request, even on async dispatch.

GOAL: wire the filter into the chain + enforce URL-level RBAC for trades/recon/audit. DONE WHEN: SecurityFilterChain disables CSRF, session STATELESS, permits /api/auth/login + /actuator/health, authenticates the rest. JWT filter runs before UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter. VIEWER cannot POST, TRADER cannot DELETE, RECON_ANALYST can resolve — enforced at URL layer + reinforced with @PreAuthorize.

GOAL: @WebMvcTest posting a valid trade as TRADER, asserting 201 + Location. DONE WHEN: class @WebMvcTest(TradeController.class), @MockBean TradeService. Method @WithMockUser(roles=TRADER) + CSRF postprocessor on the request. Asserts status 201, Location contains the new id, JSON body fields ($.id, $.tradeRef).

GOAL: prove a POST with no auth is rejected before the controller. DONE WHEN: method has no @WithMockUser. Assertion is status().isUnauthorized() (401), not isForbidden() (403). No service interaction verified — request never reaches the controller.

GOAL: prove an authenticated wrong-role user gets 403 on a state-changing endpoint. DONE WHEN: runs with @WithMockUser(roles=VIEWER). Assertion is status().isForbidden() (403). Service stub not called — denial happens at the security layer, not the controller.

Summary: TICKET-ADV078 — Full lifecycle integration test with Testcontainers
Description: GOAL: drive a real Postgres-backed Spring Boot through the full trade lifecycle over HTTP. DONE WHEN: @SpringBootTest(RANDOM_PORT) on a PostgreSQLContainer(postgres:16-alpine) via @ServiceConnection. Ordered tests log in as admin@db.com, capture JWT, then POST /trades, GET /trades, PATCH /status, POST /recon/run, PUT /recon/results/{id}/resolve — every status code asserted. Green on a fresh machine with Docker.

Summary: TICKET-ADV079 — Verify Liquibase ran on a fresh DB
Description: GOAL: prove every Liquibase changeset applies cleanly on an empty Postgres + seed lands. DONE WHEN: a second integration test spins up its own PostgreSQLContainer, asserts databasechangelog row count >= expected. Asserts >=10 rows in trades with deleted_at IS NULL (seed). Catches a forgotten-to-commit changeset XML — fails immediately on a clean container.

GOAL: establish /api/v1/... as the contract prefix + show clean endpoint deprecation. DONE WHEN: every controller @RequestMapping carries /api/v1/. An example deprecated endpoint returns 410 Gone with Deprecation: true, a Sunset date header, a Link header to the successor. README note: breaking changes get a new version segment; old segment works until its sunset date.
